name: capture_fm
label: FM-band capture
description: Writes a wideband slice of the FM broadcast band to /tmp/ferrite-fm-100.100mhz_iq-s16.wav (plus sidecar) for offline diagnosis. All-native graph: Source placeholder → FileIqSink, no browser side. Run via `ferrited --flowgraph capture_fm.json --source-type SoapySource --source-args "driver=sdrplay" --agc true --source-bandwidth-hz 1536000 --start`. Stop ferrited after ~10s — FileIqSink's max_seconds cap also truncates the write.
